decision: OI/funding/depth gates reduce DD in some samples but reduce absolute target profit, do not beat prior 13479 JPY 10bps H24 reference. No adoption. Liquidation data, full independent validation, synthetic and integrated outstanding.

protocol.features: OI6h and long-short account ratio from Binance metrics >=5 minutes prior; depth +/-1% notional imbalance >=1 min prior, funding last settled rate strictly prior with age <=12h. Funding archives through Oct2026 so November unavailable. No imputation.
protocol.exits: H24, H48, H48 TP8; STOP8 conservative gap. Original wallet .30x per position 2 slots and 12h cooldown, 10/30bps. Compare each gate to same feature-available cohort, not unrestricted baseline. No actual liquidation events.
protocol.control: For each gate arm/ex with 3 positive periods and >=8 admitted trades per period, 32 fixed-seed random thinning of available original tape, matched by UTC calendar month and candidate count. Zero control sample means no claim. Selection post R15; not untouched.
protocol.scope: Fund rate feature only where archived; no OI/board fictional reconstruction. Actual funding PnL sensitivity separately R15 target proxy; no production.
